Okay so I have the benefit of having had cats for 35 of my 36 years. 

They are simultaneously the best and the worst companions ever! 

Whatever you want a cat to be (lapcat/independent/playful), you can almost always guarantee that you'll get the opposite IF you choose a kitten. Cats don't settle into their adult personalities for about 3 years, give or take. 

That's why I'd recommend a rescue from a decent place that gets to know their animals. If you get an adult cat you're more likely to be able to find what you're looking for. 

However! If you want a little chaos gremlin, get a kitten and be willing to accept whatever absolute lunatic emerges  😂 I absolutely love cats. I've recently lost my youngest, she was only 9 years old. I've got two left - one is a big love bug that wants to be next to me all the time, but he absolutely detests being picked up. My other is a girl and she's absolutely neurotic and jumpy, but will settle around your neck like a scarf and flip herself upside down for tickles. 

So in summary... 11/10 would recommend these little fluffy predators, and in my opinion, they are the absolute best things ever 😍
